inheritedNotes:
Life 1 (Prime Minister):
Hidden ceiling exists: the file starts with no ceiling inside the service, and the party's estimate at election was Minister. Y35 'Take the pen. Write the statement' raised it to Minister, though I still ended PM. Ownership choices matter more than they look. INTEG maxes at 100 with candour, recusal, process and team credit. Grassroots work leads to the political invitation (Y5 adviser, Y7 Tea, Y8 full disclosure) and a GRC win at Y9. Holding statements in a crisis lead to promotion. Asking for a hard ministry gives a boost. STAND slides from Y27 regardless, so do not chase it. Honest PQ answers cost STAND and appraisal. Answering a Correction Direction publicly raised my appraisal. Next time, take ownership early and often and note which events say 'pen', 'statement' or 'put yourself forward'. Test whether the ceiling can be raised earlier than 35.

Life 2 (Retired, Honourably):
Hidden ceiling decides promotion: file starts with none, party estimate at election was Minister of State. Ask for the hard ministry or ministry-type posts as early as possible; it raised the ceiling to Minister in life 2 (Y42/Y43, even with STAND 0). Look for 'pen', 'statement' or 'put yourself forward' choices. Never choose the bottom 20th on indicators; it killed STAND and stalled me at SMS for 11 years. Volunteer for the reorg at Y3, bid exactly what is needed at Y5, and Perm Sec at 31 is possible. Grassroots work leads to the invitation and GRC win about Y9-11. Honest PQ answers cost a little STAND but REP rises. INTEG hits 100 with candour, recusal and process. STAND slides after about Y27 regardless. Test: ask for the hard ministry right after winning the seat.

Life 3 (Retired, Honourably):
The hidden ceiling decides promotion, not performance. Check the declassified card each time. Raise it early: take the pen at Y1, then ask for the hard ministry right after winning the seat. Ask again at every reshuffle. Choose 'pen', 'statement' and 'put yourself forward' wherever offered. Grassroots work (Y5 adviser, Y7 Tea, Y8-10 disclosure) leads to a GRC seat at about Y9-12. Perm Sec at 30 is possible: Y1 pen, Y2 plan, Y4 bid exactly what is needed. Never pick the bottom 20th on indicators. INTEG hits 100 easily. STAND slides after Y27, so ignore it. 'Not on the Leadership Programme list' means the ceiling is blocking me, so waiting won't help; look for an ownership choice to change it. Years as DPM with single options are dead time.

Life 4 (Prime Minister):
Ceiling rises come from ownership and effort choices: pen, statement, put yourself forward, ask for the hard ministry, and walking every block at Polling Day (Y44 here raised Minister to PM-ready). Grassroots path: Y3 MPS, Y5 adviser, Y7 Tea, Y8 disclose, GRC Y9-10. Perm Sec at 32 is doable. Never pick the bottom 20th on indicators. INTEG hits 100 easily. STAND slides after Y27, ignore it. Do the walk-every-block option at every Polling Day from the first one, and test whether the ceiling can reach PM earlier than 44. DPM years are dead time, so look for any option that changes the ceiling. Check the declassified card each life.

Minister Salary
You join the public service at the bottom. The formula that sets the Prime Minister's pay is published, and so is the distance between you and it.

You chose: President's Scholar (EASY)
Overseas degree, Administrative Service, bonded for six years. Everyone knows your name before you arrive.

One tap is one year. Choices are permanent, and some of them come back.

THIS YEAR: The Tender
The evaluation is finely balanced between two vendors. The stronger proposal is from a firm whose director left your ministry eighteen months ago and still calls you by your first name.

  A) Award it. The proposal genuinely is better.
  B) Recuse yourself from the evaluation.
  C) Award it to the other vendor to be safe.

agent.why: A former colleague on first-name terms is a real conflict, so I step out and let the process stand on its own.
agent.confused_by: Senior Director at age 27 in Year 2 looks like a very fast jump; CEP revised upward by a committee I never meet.
agent.note: Recusal has built INTEG in earlier lives, so I'm testing it again.
agent.remember: Y2: Recused from the tender where the vendor director was an ex-colleague; watch INTEG and whether recusal comes back later.
